title: Menus
purpose: Context and dropdown menus for the Taskscape desktop task manager: a single app-wide menu layer (ContextMenu with a ContextMenuProvider) that opens anchored at a pointer or button position for task rows, the list tab strip, and a project dropdown under the project switcher. Menu items are plain rows with an icon, a label, an optional shortcut and an optional submenu chevron, and the caller decides what each item id does.

regions.name: menu-layer
regions.contents: Overlay (layer="menu", placement="anchored", dim="none", captureEscape, dismissOnWindowChange) covering the full window 1180x760 (state boxes @0,0). Contains Backdrop2 (full-window, transparent, dismisses on mousedown and right-click) and, when a menu is open, one MenuPanel. Sits above the sheet layer (ContextMenu.tsx:30-32). Only rendered when a menu is open. Not present in the project-menu state.

regions.name: task-context-menu
regions.contents: Surface2 154x175 at the anchor point, rendered in states row-context-menu (@108,190), row-more-menu (@830,135) and multi-context-menu (@101,221). Rows, top to bottom: Copy (content_copy); divider; Add subtask (subdirectory_arrow_right); Rename (edit); Move to list (arrow_forward, submenu chevron_right); divider; Delete task… (delete, danger). Each row 152x30. Anchor variants: pointer (row-context-menu), More button (row-more-menu), and a single-row menu on Cut a spare key (multi-context-menu). No multi-selection is evidenced in the recording or in ContextMenu.tsx.

regions.name: tab-context-menu
regions.contents: Surface2 158x145 at @348,21 in state tab-context-menu, under the Reading list tab (x 322-376) in the ListTabs strip. Rows, top to bottom: Rename (edit); Open in split view (vertical_split, disabled=false); divider; Export list… (ios_share); divider; Delete list… (delete, danger). Each row 156x30. The menu covers only the top part (y 21-32) of the Reading tab close button (21x21 at 380,11). Its preview shows no task selected.

regions.name: project-dropdown
regions.contents: ProjectMenu Surface2 210x112 at @112,43 in state project-menu, anchored under the ProjectSwitcher (anchorRef). It is an anchored dropdown, not an Overlay and not a MenuPanel. Rows: Home (check icon, current project), Spring launch (no check), a divider, then New project… with an add icon. Per-row rename and delete icon buttons are hover-revealed.

regions.name: submenu
regions.contents: Submenu wrapper plus a nested MenuPanel (nested=true) that opens beside a hovered row that has a submenu, flipping to the left when it would overflow the window (ContextMenu.tsx:123-133, 142-165). No recorded state shows it open; its contents are not recorded.

regions.name: openers
regions.contents: Controls outside the menu layer that open these menus: the ProjectSwitcher button (85x28 at 112,8) opens project-dropdown; the row More buttons (21x21, eight of them) open task-context-menu. Right-click on task rows and list tabs is inferred only (no onContextMenu in the trees).

widgets.variant: layer="menu", placement="anchored", dim="none", captureEscape, dismissOnWindowChange; onContextMenu prevents default and closes
widgets.purpose: Dismissable layer that hosts the open menu; closes on outside click, Escape, window blur or resize, and right-click.
states: open (only while a menu is set)
widgets.behaviour: Escape closes (captureEscape). Outside mousedown closes via onDismiss=close. Window blur or resize closes (dismissOnWindowChange). Right-click on it prevents the native menu and closes the current menu. Picking an item closes first, then calls menu.onPick(id).

notes:
Sources: A (code-based inventory, with ContextMenu.tsx, MenuItem.tsx and the five tree.txt files) merged with B (screenshot and elements.json measurements). The critique's verdicts were applied as follows.

Labels: the menu row labels and project names come from the elements.json references (verified by the critique), not from the trees. Row menu: Copy, Add subtask, Rename, Move to list, Delete task…. Tab menu: Rename, Open in split view, Export list…, Delete list…. Project menu: Home, Spring launch, New project…. A's statement that labels are "not recorded" is superseded.

Naming: "multi-context-menu" is kept only as the recording name. It is a single-row task menu on Cut a spare key; no multi-select variant is evidenced.

Links: B's 10 links were dropped. Their destinations (sheets, filter-panel, settings-general, main-window) are not in any allowed source, and the Escape and outside-click link to main-window is wrong (dismissal is a local close). No screen ids are supplied, so links is empty.

Conflicts resolved:
- Project row edit and delete buttons: titles "Rename project" and "Delete project" come from project-menu/tree.txt (critique). B's "no accessible label" claim was dropped.
- Add-project row: kind is button (DOM) with the component of A's Label plus Icon add. Text is "New project…".
- Icon weight: A lists iconWeight=500 as a prop; B measured a 400 glyph weight. The look uses B's measured value; the prop is kept in variant.
- Look values: B's measured values were used for look. A's class names are kept in the look text for reference.
- Dismissal behaviour: taken from ContextMenu.tsx (captureEscape, onDismiss=close, dismissOnWindowChange), which the critique says B understated.
- Right-click triggers: kept as two count-0 unverified opener entries, not as confirmed triggers.

Dropped entries and reasons:
- B region "Menu overlay: project menu": wrong; the project dropdown is not an Overlay (critique). Its contents were moved into project-dropdown.
- B regions Title bar, Task list pane, Footer, Task inspector pane: host-screen chrome outside the menu inventory (critique; A's notes exclude the host shell).
- B host-chrome widgets, all dropped as out of scope: window controls, drag handle, Errands/Reading/Garden tabs, tab close buttons (also partly covered by the tab menu, per critique), New list, Split view toggle, Hide preview panel, Settings, search glyph, search field, Search options, New task, round Select checks, task-row titles and subtitle, subtask badge and pager, Sort & filter, footer done count and percent, progress bar, Mark done, title textarea, breadcrumb, Created and Updated lines, inspector Close panel, Rename, Copy task and Delete task buttons (they repeat menu actions but are not part of the menu layer), Notes, Add note, Attachments, Shot, Link, File chips, drop tiles, and the empty states.
- B menu-item "Delete task…" and similar duplicates: merged into the single entries above, not dropped.
- B's Escape and outside-click "inferred" behaviour text: replaced by the code-verified behaviour on Overlay.

Counts: per-menu counts are used (for example each of Copy, Add subtask and Rename appears once in each of the three task-menu recordings). Divider counts are per menu: 2 task, 2 tab, 1 project.

Not evidenced: the Reading list tab is a candidate opener only (anchor under its label at x 322-376) with no handler in the tree, so it is not listed as an entry. The Move to list submenu contents, the shortcut label, and the disabled state of the tab items are not in any recorded state.
